note: Real first-call response from a fresh visitor, captured live 2026-09-22. Vend has no API key; a stranger's first call returns an HTTP 402 paywall with a metered XNO price and pay_to, until they settle and retry with the block hash. On the free tier (first 5 calls/IP/day) the same endpoint returns real data with status 200 and 'trial_remaining' in the body. This is the exact 402 challenge body returned by GET /api/v1/extract?url=https://example.com (and the same shape for every endpoint).
